material_definitions: Scheelite type solid electrolytes, Li(0.5)Ce(0.5-x)Ln(x)MoO4 (x=0 and 0.25, Ln=Pr, Sm), have been synthesized using a solid state method.
Their structure was confirmed by single crystal X-ray diffraction, revealing a scheelite structure with a space group of I4_1/a.
The unsubstituted Li(0.5)Ce(0.5)MoO4 showed lithium ion conductivity in the temperature range of 300-700 degrees C.
The substituted compounds show lower conductivity compared to the unsubstituted compound, suggesting potential use in high temperature lithium battery operations.
Scheelite type lithium ion conductors have also attracted interest particularly for lithium battery operation at high temperature (300– 600)°C.
It has been reported that substituted scheelite $A_{1-r}Li_{2x}BO_4$ (A = Ca, Sr, Ba and B = W, Mo) shows liquid-like ionic conductivity in the temperature range of 700–900°C.

material_definitions: The studied compounds are part of the solid solution series Li0.5Ce0.5-xLnxMoO4, where x=0 (LCM), x=0.25 with Ln=Pr (LCPM), or x=0.25 with Ln=Sm (LCSM).
Ionic conductivity measurements were performed using ac-impedance spectroscopy in the temperature range from 30°C to 700°C.
Samples were tested in two states: as-synthesized ('unheated') and samples heat-treated at 120°C under vacuum for 12 hours ('preheated') to remove adsorbed moisture.
